title: App Community Growth Specialist
description:
About the Company

At RENPHO, we are driven by the mission to make wellness accessible to everyone. From smart scales and massagers to fitness devices, our innovative products bridge the gap between technology and personal well-being. With a global presence and over 20 millions of customers, we are dedicated to delivering products that enhance lives, promote healthier habits, and improve overall well-being.
Founded in 2016, we grew to become a market leader on Amazon with its smart consumer electronics products. With offices in Los Angeles, Europe, Hong Kong, Korea, Taiwan and Tokyo. We are currently looking to expand our team.

Job Summary

We are seeking a creative and community-focused App Community Growth Specialist to build, manage, and grow our app community. This role will be responsible for creating an engaging user environment, increasing community participation, encouraging referral activities, and developing strategies to improve user engagement and retention.

The ideal candidate understands mobile app communities, user behavior, digital engagement, and creative community-building strategies. This person will help transform our app community from a user platform into an active and connected ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities:

App Community Management & Growth

Manage and grow the app-based user community by creating an engaging and interactive experience.
Develop community strategies to increase user participation, engagement, and retention.
Monitor community activities, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
Build programs that encourage users to return, participate, and share the app with others.

User Engagement & Community Activities

Create engaging content, discussions, challenges, campaigns, and interactive activities within the app community.
Develop creative initiatives to make the community experience more fun, valuable, and memorable.
Encourage user-generated content and meaningful conversations among community members.
Recognize and nurture active users and community advocates.

Referral Program Engagement

Develop creative campaigns to increase referral participation and user acquisition.
Identify opportunities to motivate users to invite friends and expand the community.
Analyze referral activities and provide recommendations to improve conversion and engagement.
Collaborate with marketing teams on referral campaigns and promotions.

Community Feedback & User Insights

Serve as the voice of the app community by collecting and analyzing user feedback.
Identify user needs, pain points, and opportunities to improve the app experience.
Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Customer Support teams to communicate community insights.

Community Performance Tracking

Track and analyze key community metrics, including:
Active community users
User engagement rate
Referral participation
Campaign performance
User retention
Prepare reports and recommendations to improve community growth.

Cross-functional Collaboration

Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Growth, and Customer Experience teams.
Support app launches, feature releases, and user engagement initiatives.
Assist in developing strategies to strengthen the overall app ecosystem.

Qualifications

* 5+ years of experience in community management, app operations, social media, digital
marketing, or user engagement.
* Experience managing online communities or mobile app communities preferred.
* Strong understanding of user engagement strategies and community-building practices.
* Creative mindset with the ability to develop campaigns and interactive experiences.
* Strong communication skills and ability to connect with users.
* Data-driven approach with the ability to analyze engagement performance.
* Experience with referral programs, consumer apps, or digital platforms is a plus.

title: Lifecycle Marketing Manager
description:
About the Company

At RENPHO, our mission is to make wellness accessible, practical, and part of everyday life. We design smart, user-friendly products—from body composition scales to massage and fitness devices—that seamlessly integrate technology with personal well-being.
Since our founding in 2016, RENPHO has grown into a leading global brand in consumer health technology, serving over 20 million users worldwide. Our products are trusted by customers across major marketplaces, including Amazon, where we have established a strong market presence.
As we continue to expand globally, we remain focused on innovation, data-driven insights, and delivering meaningful experiences that help people better understand and improve their wellness and health journey .

About the Role
Renpho is seeking a Lifecycle Marketing Manager to own the execution and optimization of customer communication across email and SMS.
This role will ensure consistent, timely, and relevant messaging throughout the customer journey, from initial engagement through post-purchase and reactivation. Working closely with the DTC team, this role will support key business initiatives by improving how and when we communicate with our customers.

Key Responsibilities
Build and manage automated lifecycle flows (welcome, post-purchase, win-back, etc.), ensuring consistent communication across key customer stages
Execute weekly email and SMS campaigns aligned with DTC priorities, including promotions, product launches, and seasonal moments
Develop and apply customer segmentation to improve targeting, personalization, and overall relevance of messaging
Maintain CRM platform operations, including campaign setup, data quality, and deliverability standards
Track performance across campaigns and flows, providing insights to support ongoing optimization and testing
Partner with DTC, Creative, and Web teams to ensure accurate, timely, and consistent execution across all customer touchpoints

Qualifications
3–5+ years in email marketing, CRM, or lifecycle marketing within DTC
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo or similar platforms
Experience building and managing automated lifecycle flows
Strong execution skills with attention to detail and follow-through
Basic understanding of segmentation, testing, and campaign performance
Clear written communication skills for North American audiences

What Success Looks Like
Consistent execution of campaigns and lifecycle flows across key business moments
Improved structure and coverage of lifecycle communication across the customer journey
Strong CRM platform organization, data quality, and deliverability
Clear visibility into performance to support DTC decision-making

title: Sales Operations Specialist Americas
description:
About the role

RENPHO is seeking a bilingual Sales Operations Specialist to provide centralized operational support for our sales business across the Americas, including the United States and South America.
Based at our Eastvale warehouse location, this person will connect the Americas sales team with colleagues in China and our warehouse, customer service, finance, and supply chain teams. The role keeps customer requirements, product information, orders, inventory status, and delivery timelines accurate and actionable.
We are looking for someone who understands how physical products move from available inventory through order processing, warehouse fulfillment, and customer delivery. You will learn RENPHO's internal systems, clarify requirements in English and Mandarin Chinese, and turn them into clear next steps for the sales team and internal partners.

Responsibilities:

China and Americas coordination

Serve as a central operational contact for the Americas sales team and colleagues in China.
Use English and Mandarin Chinese to clarify customer requirements, internal processes, order status, and outstanding decisions.
Learn company systems and workflows; help salespeople understand required inputs, approval steps, timelines, and dependencies.
Turn requests and meetings into clear actions, owners, and deadlines, following up through completion.
Raise unresolved issues with a concise explanation of the customer impact and the decision needed.

Orders, inventory, and fulfillment coordination

Maintain visibility into customer purchase orders, processing status, inventory availability, warehouse readiness, and delivery commitments.
Work with warehouse and supply chain teams to confirm stock availability, inbound timing, order release requirements, and expected fulfillment dates before commitments are made to customers.
Understand customer receiving requirements, shipping windows, delivery appointments, and documentation needs; coordinate with the teams responsible for execution.
Track backorders, inventory discrepancies, delayed receipts, shipment exceptions, and proof of delivery, keeping salespeople informed of changes affecting customers.
Coordinate product samples and support resolution of returns, shortages, and other order issues.

Customer and account operations

Support national and regional retailers, distributors, marketplace partners, and other B2B customers across the Americas.
Coordinate customer onboarding, account documentation, product setup, and routine customer requests.
Maintain accurate customer, product, approved pricing, and order records in company systems.
Gather product specifications, UPCs/GTINs, case packs, dimensions, and other information needed for account setup and fulfillment.
Support finance with invoice discrepancies, deductions, and payment questions by gathering records and coordinating follow-up.
Maintain current price lists and product availability information; assist with routine quotations and customer materials using approved inputs.

Reporting and process improvement

Prepare regular reports on sales, open orders, inventory constraints, upcoming commitments, and unresolved issues.
Reconcile information across sales and operational systems and investigate discrepancies with the appropriate owners.
Maintain practical procedures and trackers that improve handoffs between sales, China teams, and warehouses.
Identify recurring delays or missing information and recommend improvements.

Qualifications:

Professional working proficiency in English and Mandarin Chinese, including speaking, reading, and writing for day-to-day business coordination.
3-5 years of experience in sales operations, order management, customer operations, or sales support within a business selling physical products.
Working understanding of purchase orders, inventory availability, warehouse fulfillment, and customer delivery timelines.
Experience coordinating with warehouses, supply chain teams, or distribution operations.
Strong Excel skills and experience working with ERP, order management, CRM, or inventory systems.
Ability to learn internal processes and explain them clearly to salespeople and other stakeholders.
Strong organization, attention to detail, and follow-through across multiple accounts and deadlines.
Practical judgment about what can be resolved independently and what requires approval or escalation.
Ability to work on site and participate in scheduled coordination with China-based colleagues across time zones.

Preferred experience

Supporting retailers, distributors, or ecommerce marketplace accounts.
Consumer electronics, wellness products, manufacturing, import/distribution, or other physical consumer goods.
Working with China-based headquarters or operations teams.
Customer receiving requirements, EDI orders, retailer portals, or warehouse management systems.
Supporting sales or customer operations in Latin America.
Bachelor's degree in business or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

What success looks like

Salespeople have reliable information on inventory, orders, and delivery timelines.
Customer and internal requests have clear owners, deadlines, and follow-through.
China and Americas teams understand the same requirements and next steps.
Order and fulfillment risks are surfaced early, with a plan for resolution.
Account records and operational reports are accurate and current.
Sales leadership spends less time chasing updates and resolving routine operational issues.

title: Influencer & Creator Partnerships Manager
description:
About RENPHO
At RENPHO, we believe technology should make wellness, beauty, and self-care more accessible, intuitive, and part of everyday life.
Founded in 2016, RENPHO has grown into a global consumer technology brand serving more than 20 million users worldwide. Our portfolio spans smart wellness devices, beauty technology, and recovery solutions designed to help people better understand, care for, and improve their well-being.

As we continue to grow, we're focused on building a stronger brand presence, creating meaningful connections with consumers, and becoming part of the conversations shaping modern wellness and beauty.

About the Role

We're looking for a passionate, well-connected, and culturally curious Influencer & Creator Partnerships Manager to build and grow RENPHO's creator ecosystem in the United States.
This is a relationship-driven role focused primarily on organic influencer engagement, creator discovery, product seeding, and long-term partnerships.

We're looking for someone who genuinely understands the creator landscape, knows how to identify influential voices across different communities, and has the ability to turn authentic relationships into compelling content, meaningful engagement, and brand growth.
You should be equally comfortable connecting with established creators and discovering emerging talent before everyone else does.

Rather than focusing on transactional influencer recruitment, you'll help build a community of creators who genuinely connect with RENPHO's products and want to share their experiences.
The ideal candidate combines strong industry relationships, cultural awareness, creative instincts, and an analytical understanding of social media performance.

Key Responsibilities:

Influencer Discovery & Relationship Building
Build and maintain a strong network of US-based influencers, content creators, and emerging social media talent.
Establish authentic, long-term relationships with creators through personalized outreach, product experiences, and ongoing engagement.
Develop and manage a curated roster of creators who align with RENPHO's brand values, product categories, and target audiences.
Identify high-potential creators capable of generating exceptional organic reach, engagement, and brand visibility.
Develop relationships that extend beyond individual campaigns, encouraging ongoing product discovery, advocacy, and content collaboration.
Build and maintain a structured creator database, tracking relationships, product interests, collaboration history, and performance.

Creator Audience Development & Community Intelligence
Map and develop creator communities across relevant consumer audiences, including:
Beauty, skincare, and beauty technology
Wellness, self-care, and healthy living
Fitness, sports, and active lifestyles
Recovery, relaxation, and mindfulness
Travel and lifestyle
Men's wellness and grooming
Women's wellness and lifestyle
LGBTQ+ lifestyle and wellness communities
Technology, gadgets, and product discovery
Identify influential voices, emerging trends, and underserved creator communities.
Evaluate creators based on audience relevance, content quality, engagement, authenticity, and growth potential.
Maintain an active understanding of the US influencer landscape across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other relevant platforms.
Recommend new creator audiences and partnership opportunities based on product launches, seasonal priorities, and consumer trends.

Organic Influencer Activation & Product Seeding
Develop and execute a scalable, product-led influencer engagement program.
Match RENPHO products with creators whose interests, lifestyles, and content naturally align with the product experience.
Manage personalized product seeding initiatives, including creator selection, outreach, product coordination, follow-up, and relationship development.
Encourage authentic product discovery and voluntary organic content creation while respecting creators' editorial independence.
Identify opportunities for collaborative Instagram posts, Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube content, and other formats that can expand RENPHO's organic reach.
Work closely with the Social Media team to amplify high-performing creator content through appropriate collaborations and reposting.
Ensure all creator activities follow applicable disclosure requirements and brand guidelines.

Strategic Creator Partnerships
Identify a select group of high-potential creators who can become long-term brand partners and advocates.
Develop creative collaboration opportunities that go beyond traditional sponsored posts.
Recognize creators with exceptional audience influence and the potential to significantly accelerate RENPHO's brand visibility.
Build deeper partnerships around product launches, experiential activations, events, and ongoing brand storytelling.
Recommend paid partnerships, affiliate arrangements, and longer-term agreements when organic performance, audience fit, and commercial potential justify additional investment.
Support negotiation and management of creator agreements when applicable.

Performance, Analytics & Optimization
Track and evaluate the performance of influencer and creator activities, with an emphasis on:
Organic reach and content views
Engagement rates and audience interaction
Performance of collaborative posts
Earned creator content and brand mentions
Audience growth and new follower acquisition
Creator relationship development and retention
Identify top-performing creators and analyze the factors contributing to their
success.
Monitor affiliate performance, attributed sales, and conversion metrics where
relevant.
Develop regular performance reporting that highlights meaningful results, emerging
opportunities, and recommendations.
Use performance insights to continuously refine creator selection, product matching,
and partnership development.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with Social Media, Brand Marketing, PR, Product Marketing, and E-commerce teams.
Support new product launches through targeted creator outreach and product discovery initiatives.
Coordinate with Creative and Social Media teams to maximize the visibility of high-performing creator content.
Identify opportunities to integrate creators into brand campaigns, events, experiential marketing, and product storytelling.
Contribute insights from the creator community to help inform RENPHO's broader marketing and brand development.

Qualifications:

Required
3–5+ years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media, or talent relations, preferably within a US consumer brand.
Demonstrated experience building and maintaining authentic relationships with US-based influencers and content creators.
An established network of creator contacts and a strong understanding of the US influencer landscape.
Proven ability to discover, evaluate, and engage creators across different audience segments.
Experience managing organic influencer programs, product seeding, and creator collaborations.
Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging creator platforms.
Ability to evaluate creator performance using reach, views, engagement, audience quality, and other relevant metrics.
Excellent interpersonal communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple creator relationships simultaneously.
Creative instincts and an understanding of what makes social content compelling and shareable.
Genuine interest in wellness, beauty, lifestyle, and consumer technology.

Preferred
Existing relationships with creators in beauty, wellness, fitness, travel, or lifestyle.
Experience building organic influencer programs from the ground up.
Experience identifying emerging creators and developing them into long-term brand partners.
Familiarity with affiliate marketing programs and creator monetization models.
Experience with influencer management platforms such as GRIN, Aspire, CreatorIQ, or similar tools.
Experience working with product-driven DTC or consumer technology brands.
Understanding of creator content usage rights, partnership agreements, and influencer marketing compliance.
Experience supporting creator activations at brand events, product launches, or experiential marketing initiatives.

What Success Looks Like
Success in this role is measured by the quality and impact of the creator relationships you build—not simply the number of influencers contacted or products distributed.

You'll help RENPHO:
Establish a strong, growing network of engaged creators across priority consumer audiences.
Build meaningful relationships that generate authentic brand advocacy and recurring collaboration opportunities.
Increase organic brand visibility through creator-generated content, collaborative posts, and social engagement.
Identify standout creators capable of delivering exceptional reach and audience growth.
Develop a repeatable, scalable product seeding and organic influencer engagement program.
Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of creator outreach and partnership development.
Create a foundation for selective paid partnerships, affiliate collaborations, and long-term brand ambassadorships.

Ultimately, you'll help transform RENPHO's influencer marketing from a series of individual activations into a connected community of creators who genuinely believe in the brand.

Who Will Thrive Here
You're naturally curious about people, culture, and social media.
You know who is creating interesting content, which voices are gaining influence, and why certain creators connect so strongly with their audiences.
You understand that a creator with 30,000 highly engaged followers can sometimes deliver more meaningful impact than someone with a million.
You enjoy discovering talent, building relationships, introducing people to products you believe in, and creating opportunities for collaboration.
You're proactive, resourceful, commercially aware, and comfortable building programs from the ground up.

Most importantly, you believe that the strongest influencer partnerships begin with genuine relationships—not transactions.
Location: Irvine, California (On-site)
Employment Type: Full-time
Seniority Level: Mid-level / Experienced Individual Contributor
Industry: Consumer Technology | Wellness | Beauty Tech | Lifestyle | E-commerce
